_note: Vocabulary of Kaos acts. Beat sheets may only use these ids; the renderer (render/acts.js) implements every one. Add an act here and in the renderer together.

acts.talk: stands facing camera, mouth moves with the voice, small gestures
acts.shock: jaw drops, eyes wide, small jump back
acts.panic: sweat drop, flailing arms, fast shuffle
acts.think: chin on hand, looks up, thought bubble dots
acts.walk_in: walks in from the side to centre
acts.tap_phone: pulls out a phone and taps it, expression turns hopeful
acts.present: arm sweeps toward the screen like a presenter
acts.point: points at the screen or at the text
acts.celebrate: arms up, confetti, a little hop
acts.wave: friendly wave to camera, goes to the end card
